summary.interpretation: A cohort ACCEPTs only if some closed year yields a unique argmax that is NEITHER the total-citations winner NOR the works winner, with rel separation >= 0.05 and |rho vs total| <= 0.45. Those two SHORTCUT gates are the point: the total and works keys ARE server-sortable, so if the year winner coincides with either, a solver reaches the answer in one call and the enumeration the prompt demands is decorative.
